column1: # Brulart de Leon cipher (1615-18): the key values checked in the runs of R2785 and R2786
# Compiled 14 Nov 2026 from the key_check column of texts/R2785_align.tsv and texts/R2786_align.tsv (22 Oct 2026), nothing added.
# This is not the whole key. The key is Satoshi Tomokiyo's reconstruction (table on DECODE R2785/R2786, DOC_2785, and on
# cryptiana louisxiii.htm), which is not copied here. The rows below are the values of his key that the align files state
# for a sign, with the runs where each is stated; the one addition of this project is the last row (θ = null).
# Number groups are written as in the align files (a comma or a bar after the figure is part of the sign as read; the align
# files write some groups with and without the comma, e.g. 20, and 20: they are listed once here).
# Stated in the align files as outside the key: 4 under the decipherer's 'autre' (R2785 run 4; the key has 6 = autre),
# 85 under 'nous' (R2785 run 6), a figure read 10 under 'de' (R2785 run 2).
